definitions.explanation: The middle point or part of something.
Relating to the main governing body or headquarters, as opposed to local or regional entities.

notes:
{中央|ちゅうおう} means the center or middle, often in formal, institutional, or geographic contexts. Combines {中|ちゅう} (middle) + {央|おう} (center).

COMPOUNDS:
- {中央|ちゅうおう}⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧ (central government)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧ (central bank)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (Chuo Line — major Tokyo train line)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}⟦{分離帯|ぶんりたい}→分離帯：noentry⟧ (road median)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}⟦{集権|しゅうけん}→集権：noentry⟧ (centralization of power)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {中央|ちゅうおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (to place in the center)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧ (to be located in the center)

- ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧: center, middle (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧: core, heart, center (figurative importance: ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧の⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧)
